Revision.why: Without it a corrected meaning or column overwrites the old one, and 'what did this report say when that document was produced' has no answer. Compliance asks exactly that.
Revision.alternatives: Relying on git history of the YAML files: rejected because the graph and its consumers cannot query it, it records who committed rather than who accepted, and it has no reason or effective date.
